reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in your DM thread. I confirmed that Caspian Halvorsen is now their go-to escalation contact at Marrow Agrisupply for the Nettle rollout, and that this stays between the two of you.

I didn't save it as a separate gbrain fact. The brain already records this DM in a way only Hollis can see. The `remember` tool didn't make clear who could see a new entry, so a separate save risked showing Hollis's private note to others.
